content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body:
$RL 363: buyers held it 5 times in the past year
$RL 367: sellers turned it back 5 times across three years
The reclaim has to clear 367.
$TRIP sits above 8.32, where most six-month volume traded.

queue.headline: $TBBK is at the lower edge of its six-month range
queue.body: That floor is 48.1. Below it, the range is gone.
$FBK back above 53.1, the average price paid since the September spike.

queue.headline: $ESE has closed green 3 weeks in a row
queue.body: A close through 275 changes the structure. Until then, the streak is just repair.

queue.headline: $NTCT keeps holding 39.4
queue.body: The average price paid since the volume spike has held for 10 straight sessions.
$TBBK needs 50.8 back. Six-month volume is heaviest there.

queue.headline: $SYF held 70.3
queue.body: Now 2.1% above the most-traded price of the past six months.

queue.headline: $CTVA just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 77% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 277 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Semiconductors ripping, +2.7% avg on Friday
queue.body: $WOLF +13.2% $ACLS +8.1% $TER +8.0% $CAMT +7.4% $STM +7.0% $ASX +6.1% $ON +6.0% $AMKR +5.9% The whole group is bid, not one name.
$NYAX CEO Yair Nechmad made his 11th open-market buy in 180 days. The filing confirms the purchase, but not what prompted it.

123 has to hold or the setup loses its footing.

GDPNow has growth at 3.7% this quarter.
Median CPI is running at 2.1%.
Growth is firming while inflation is still a bit warm.

queue.body: 50.3 has to hold for the move to matter.

queue.headline: $FIX extends the run
queue.body: Up 5 weeks straight. A close above 1747 makes the move real.

queue.headline: $PL is back above the average price paid since the September spike
queue.body: The close cleared 17.2. The setup still needs 18.9 back before the risk improves.
$COST reclaimed 916. A close back below leaves it range-bound.
Rep. Kevin Hern sold $CR, and the filing surfaced 25 days later. It tells you what traded, not why.
Most $PANW technical signals agree. Now $403 has to hold.

$GAP reclaim line: 21.8
$GAP below that level leaves the current decline intact.
Jobless claims are averaging 200k a week this month, 11.0% below a year ago. A growth scare still isn't in the claims data.

queue.headline: $MYRG's rebound has a familiar ceiling
queue.body: A close above 309 would break the past year's rejection pattern.

$ASTH: 3rd rejection at 36.4
$ASTH: 7.5% below the high-volume price at 38.8
A close above 38.2 would change the read.
$VOO made today's most-traded list. Quiet accumulation isn't the story.
